Major Actions
Attack
The most common action taken in combat, whether by swinging a sword, firing a bow, or brawling with your fists.
Two-Weapon Fighting
When you take the Attack action and attack with a light weapon that you’re holding in one hand, you can use a Minor Action to attack with a different light weapon that you’re holding in the other hand.
Grappling
A special unarmed strike against a creature no larger than one size larger than you. On a hit, you subject them to the Grappled and Exposed condition.
Shove
A special unarmed strike against a creature no larger than one size larger than you. On a hit, you may push them back 5 ft. or knock them Prone. They are also subjected to the Exposed condition.
Cast a Spell
Cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action.
Dash
When you take the Dash action, you increase your movement for the current turn by your current speed.
Dodge
Attack rolls made against you have disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Reflex saving throws with advantage until the start of your next turn. You lose this benefit if you are incapacitated or your speed drops to 0.
Help
Aid another creature in a task or action. Until the start of your next turn, the creature you aid gains advantage on its next ability check or attack roll, so long as it is possible to help them in their task from where you currently are. Alternatively, you may instead choose a willing creature within the same area. The two of you must spend a collective 2 Heroic Inspiration to allow both you and that creature to immediately each take one type of action of your choice, describing how your combined efforts create a single, unique effect on the scene. The DM determines whether the description is coherent and feasible.
Hide
Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to attempt to hide from other creatures. The DM may set a DC or otherwise use the Passive Perception of the enemy creatures in the encounter. If you pass, you gain the Hidden condition.
Hiding in Plain Sight
If you use the Hide action without anything obstructing the line of sight between you and any opposing creatures, you take a -10 to your Dexterity (Stealth) check.
Ready
Declare an action you will take and what condition(s) must be met before you take that action as a reaction.
Search
Make an appropriate ability check to find something.
Martial Prowesses
Second Wind
You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a Minor Action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level and recover 1 Stress Slot.
Test
This is a test prowess.
